7:- [Slack](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/slack.md): Run MCPJam from Slack — mention the bot to ask about your projects, and approve the actions that spend credits
8:- [MCPJam in Claude](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/claude-connector.md): Connect Claude to your MCPJam account through the hosted MCP server — projects, saved servers, evals, and user testing
40:- [Migrating to CLI 4.0](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/migration.md): Command-path and flag changes when account-bound mcpjam commands moved under mcpjam cloud
53:- [Self-hosted MCPJam](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/self-hosted.md): Point the CLI and SDK at your organization's MCPJam server, lock it with an IT settings file, and work behind a corporate proxy
82:- [host-compat](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/host-compat.md): API reference for @mcpjam/sdk/host-compat — derive server requirements, evaluate host compatibility, and scan widget bridge usage.
92:- [List run iterations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-run-iterations.md): Per-iteration results: actual tool calls, structured token usage, and latency. Cursor-paginated.
125:- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).
129:- [Authenticate and record an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-eval-start.md): Called by official SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an eval. Requires an organization API key or saved-login bearer. Records only start metadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies no debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are intent, not completed usage. Reuse the runStartId for ret…
143:- [Get the authenticated account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/get-the-authenticated-account.md): The user behind the API key (keys act as their creator, scoped to one organization).
144:- [Read the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): The ceiling on what this organization may spend on MCPJam-billed work — chat, evals, judges and computer time — in the current billing window, and how much of it has been spent.
145:- [Set the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/set-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): Set or replace the ceiling. **Requires organization owner or admin.**
146:- [Remove the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/remove-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): Leave the organization uncapped. **Requires organization owner or admin.**
147:- [List organizations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-organizations.md): The organizations the caller belongs to — the source of the `organizationId` that `GET /projects` filters by and `POST /projects` accepts. An API key is bound to one organization and only ever sees that one. Read-only: organization, member, role and billing changes are not part of the public API.
148:- [List projects](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-projects.md): Projects the caller can access. API keys only ever see projects inside the key's organization.
195:- [List a server's accounts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/list-a-servers-accounts.md): The accounts this server signs in with that you can see: your own personal accounts, or, on a server shared with the project, its project accounts. Another member's personal account never appears. METADATA ONLY: no account response carries a token.
196:- [Get a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/get-a-server-account.md): One account, by id or name. Another member's personal account answers `404`, the same as a missing one. A name two accounts share answers `409` with `details.code: "account_name_ambiguous"` and both ids in `details.accountIds`.
197:- [Upload tokens to a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/upload-tokens-to-a-server-account.md): Creates the account (`201`) or replaces its token in place (`200`, same id). A well-formed account id never creates one: an unknown id is `404`. Any other reference is a name, and a name no account has creates the account.
198:- [Delete a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/delete-a-server-account.md): Deletes the account and its stored token. The token's issuer is asked to revoke it where the issuer supports revocation (best effort), which also invalidates any copy of the same token you hold.
199:- [Rename a server account or make it the default](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/rename-a-server-account-or-make-it-the-default.md): Rename the account, make it the default, or both; a rename applies first. A name another account on the server uses answers `409` with `details.code: "account_name_taken"`.
200:- [Import OAuth tokens](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/oauth/import-oauth-tokens.md): **Deprecated.** Use `PUT /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/accounts/{account}`. This route uploads to your default account on the server, creating an unnamed one when the server has none, and is removed 90 days after the accounts API shipped. Every answer carries `Deprecation: true`, a `Sunse…
201:- [List GitHub Checks repositories](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/list-github-checks-repositories.md): The repositories in this organization whose pull requests run an eval suite, plus the repositories the MCPJam GitHub App can reach (the choices a connect has).
203:- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/request-insights-for-an-eval-run.md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished run and draws on the same shared `insightsPerDay` request ledger as swarm and user-testing insights.
205:- [Create a project](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/create-a-project.md): Creates a project in the caller's organization and responds `201` with its detail. Requires organization membership and counts against the plan's `maxProjects` limit. Guest callers are denied.
230:- [Unpublish an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/unpublish-an-environment.md): Takes the study down. Deliberately NOT behind the beta gate that guards publishing: an organization that loses the flag must still be able to take a live study down.
241:- [Usage breakdown](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/usage-breakdown.md): Which models, tools and servers the study's sessions used.
245:- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/request-insights-for-the-current-window.md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the study's current window and draws on the organization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUESTS and is SHARED with eval-run and swarm run insights, so a request here takes one from there.
295:- [Start a Claude directory-readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-claude-directory-readiness-run.md): Grades the saved server against Anthropic's connector-directory requirements and returns `202` with a run id. The target comes from the saved server the path names: a body cannot supply a URL, an actor, an organization, a model or a cost. Poll the run detail for the verdict. Deterministic grading is…
316:- [List curated and org registry cards](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/registry/list-curated-and-org-registry-cards.md): Merges global approved cards with the project's organization cards. Guest-denied. `scope` defaults to all.
321:- [Send one agent Playground message](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/chat-sessions/send-one-agent-playground-message.md): Send one message to a project's MCP servers and get the model's reply plus the telemetry a participant in the conversation could not see: which tools ran, with what arguments, what each returned, per-call latency, and token usage.
323:- [Read a chat session's execution trace](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/chat-sessions/read-a-chat-sessions-execution-trace.md): Per-turn execution spans: per-tool-call latency, token usage, and indices into the transcript. Same span shape as the eval iteration trace.
331:- [Send feedback to the MCPJam team](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/feedback/send-feedback-to-the-mcpjam-team.md): Tell the MCPJam team about MCPJam itself (a bug, a missing capability, something confusing, or a docs gap) at the moment you hit it. THE TEXT IS SENT TO THE MCPJAM TEAM, outside your organization, and kept for 180 days. It is stored in MCPJam's own database and never published. Summarize: never incl…

Validation and quota errors surface on this request; poll `GET /eval-runs/{runId}` for progress. The run appears live in the hosted UI Runs tab, tagged `source: \"api\"`.\n\nA bare `suiteId` with no inline tests reruns the suite as configured. Per-organization concurrency is capped (default 2 concurrent runs); exceeding it returns `429` with `details.reason: \"CONCURRENT_RUN_LIMIT\"`.\n\nFor a suite with attached project environments, pass `environmentId` to choose which one the run uses; the `202` echoes the resolved `environment` triple, and `GET /eval-runs/{runId}` reports the same triple for the life of the run.\n\nTo make the run readable as something more specific than `API` in the Runs table, send `x-mcpjam-launcher` (and `x-mcpjam-ci` from a CI job).
